source_title: A Martinez Reflects on Legacy of Santa Barbara at 2026 Daytime Emmys, 33 Years After the ‘Outrageous’ Soap Ended - People.com

Julia Moore is a TV Writer-Reporter at PEOPLE. She has been working at PEOPLE since 2022.
Santa Barbara star A Martinez paid tribute to the NBC series, which ran from 1984 to 1993, at the 2026 Daytime Emmys
Martinez honored the beloved soap opera, which he said was a “wonderful place to work,” and gave a shoutout to his costar Marcy Walker, who he said “gave me my wings”
The 53rd Daytime Emmy Awards are streaming live from the Hollywood Palladium
A Martinez celebrated Santa Barbara ’s legacy at the 2026 Daytime Emmys.
On Friday, Oct. 30, Martinez — who played Cruz Castillo on Santa Barbara — paid homage to the beloved soap opera at this year’s award ceremony at the Hollywood Palladium.
“I’ve had so many people tell me that they started watching our show with their parents, their grandparents, so family is the real thing,” the actor, 78, said. “Our show was a wonderful, wonderful place to work. It started with the extraordinary writing ... and it bloomed into a culture of graciousness that played throughout the company.”
“We loved to tackle outrageous themes — and we loved to laugh,” he said of the series, which debuted on NBC in July 1984 and ran for nine seasons, through 1993.
Martinez continued, “God himself was a character on our show. And as he is my witness, he was not only powerful on our show, but he was very, very funny.”
He also shouted out “two remarkable women” he worked with on the series: producer Jill Phelps, who he said “insisted that I start taking my moments rather than run away from them,” and Marcy Walker, who he said “gave me my wings.”
“She showed me how to relax on stage for the first time in my life,” Martinez said of the actress who played Eden Capwell.
The soap opera followed the glamorous yet scandalous lives of two wealthy, rival families — the Capwells and the Lockridges — living in the California coastal town of Santa Barbara.
Along with Martinez, Santa Barbara starred Marcy Walker, Nancy Lee Grahn, Jed Allan, Robin Mattson, Judith McConnell and Robin Wright .
Over its near decade-long run, Santa Barbara earned 74 Daytime Emmy nominations, winning 24. Martinez garnered seven nods for his portrayal of Cruz, winning Outstanding Lead Actor in a Drama Series in 1990.
Martinez’s appearance at the 2026 Daytime Emmys is part of the ceremony’s tribute to beloved daytime dramas from the past. As previously announced, Juliet Mills paid homage to Passions, Crystal Chappell to Guiding Light , Lesli Kay to As the World Turns , Eva LaRue to All My Children , Joe Lando to One Life to Live, and Alicia Leigh Willis to Another World .
